findings: Setup recovery navigates obsolete crux-app://app origin and loses its recovery UI after restart.
Source-Task review trace shows the same obsolete navigation followed by a missing Review changes button and close/worker teardown timeout.

changes: A small Task command boundary requires the complete native lifecycle and file-content port before opening or settling workspaces, changing metadata or stopping a review runtime. Missing authority refuses instead of selecting a second implementation.

Removed snapshot-based Task creation/review/merge, renderer copy/store provisioning, raw review journals, archive/reopen SQL, folder/setup writes and metadata CAS fallback. Native admission, revision checks, retained states, projection/recovery and participating-turn handling remain.

Task indexing and projection require native file-content storage. Indexing still serializes with watcher ingestion and preserves stable file identity/attributes. Existing host capture/materialization compatibility remains outside this storage-command slice.

Three Task metadata tests use actual native commands; mutable queued patches, concurrent updates, commit notification, a real SQLite failure/retry and reserved-field/title/revision persistence across restart are covered.

Fingerprint registration and watcher/index ordering now use actual native manifests. The watcher timing case moves into a separate suite so cached SQL.js services cannot hide an empty native index. All existing assertion purposes remain.

Two new native safety cases refuse incomplete setup before any workspace/copy/Growth is created and refuse absent merge authority without changing checked review/candidate/Main content; restoring authority permits successful retry.

Net production reduction259 lines, including the new24-line command boundary and four-line native host recovery correction. Reviewed literal renderer SQL mutations47 to36;95 literal keys remain classified.
Two desktop journeys now navigate relative to their actual app origin rather than the obsolete crux-app://app host; no production origin or IPC trust policy changed.

Reproduced failed-Task folder-registration loss on actual restart: native folderExists returned false for an existing committed folder, so recovery bypassed unexpected-file refusal and allocated another folder. Bootstrap now registers ready/preparing/failed Task folders but watches only ready copies. Native recovery refuses without moving the folder or changing phase; retry preserves both expected and externally preserved files through another restart.
limits: This completes only the Task command/write cutover; AR06 is unfinished. The client interface remains optional during migration of remaining workflows.

Working Copy/history read compatibility and SQL.js deletion/detail fixtures remain for the next native reader slice. Garden/settings/ingestion/other service fallbacks and worker/schema/test setup still remain.
Workspace-operation ownership, sequential selected-Garden admission coordination and runtime disposal remain separate AR07-AR09 work.
API/runtime, real Garden, manual candidate and unrelated changes are preserved. No merge/deploy/live publication/payment/email occurred; fresh-head Windows/Linux CI requires separate acceptance.
